metadata.question: Was the area covered by solar panels in the Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan greater than 7,000 hectares in January 2022?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting solar panels in Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan in January 2022 and determining if the area is greater than 7,000 hectares. Strategy: 1. Location: Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan, India. I'll use coordinates around (27.54, 71.91) which is the known location. 2. Time: January 2022 3. Data: Need to identify solar panels. Solar panels have distinct spectral signatures - they typically have high reflectance in visible and NIR but low NDVI. I can use Sentinel-2 imagery and create a classification to identify solar panels. 4. Approach: - Get Sentinel-2 imagery for January 2022 - Create a solar panel detection algorithm using spectral indices - Calculate the area of detected solar panels - Compare with 7,000 hectares For solar panel detection, I can use: - Low NDVI (solar panels have vegetation-like reflectance but aren't vegetation) - High NIR reflectance - Specific band ratios that distinguish solar panels I'll need to: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the area calculation (C3) - Compare with threshold (A/B) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const bhadlaPark = ee.Geometry.Point([71.91, 27.54]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around known location const startDate = '2022-01-01'; const endDate = '2022-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for solar panel detection let s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(bhadlaPark) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); // Check if collection is empty const s2Count = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2022 Images: ${s2Count}`); if (s2Count === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mosaic and detect solar panels const mosaic = s2Col.median(); // Solar panel detection using spectral characteristics // Solar panels typically have low NDVI, high reflectance in visible/NIR const ndvi = mosaic.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const ndwi = mosaic.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Create solar panel mask (low vegetation, high reflectance) const solarMask = ndvi.lt(0.2) // Low vegetation index .and(mosaic.select('B8').gt(2000)) // High NIR reflectance .and(ndwi.lt(0.1)) // Low water index .and(mosaic.select('B4').lt(3000)); // Moderate red reflectance // 4. Calculate area const areaImage = solarMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); // Area in m² const areaStats = areaImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bhadlaPark, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const areaM2 = areaStats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Area in m²: ${areaM2}`); // Check for valid pixels if (areaM2 === null || areaM2 === undefined) { console.log("C3"); return; } const pixelCount = solarMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bhadlaPark, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Solar panel pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Convert to hectares (1 ha = 10,000 m²) const areaHectares = areaM2 / 10000; console.log(`Solar panel area: ${areaHectares.toFixed(2)} hectares`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (areaHectares > 7000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
